nw.en: From the gate, walk straight up to the main road and turn left. It is the last building on your right.
nw.zu: Usuka esangweni, hamba uqonde uye emgwaqweni omkhulu bese ujikela kwesobunxele. Yisakhiwo sokugcina ngakwesokudla sakho.

n.en: From the gate, walk straight up and cross the main road. It is directly ahead.
n.zu: Usuka esangweni, hamba uqonde bese uwela umgwaqo omkhulu. Siphambi kwakho ngqo.

ne.en: From the gate, walk straight up to the main road and turn right. It is the last building on your left.
ne.zu: Usuka esangweni, hamba uqonde uye emgwaqweni omkhulu bese ujikela kwesokudla. Yisakhiwo sokugcina ngakwesobunxele sakho.

w.en: From the gate, take the first path on your left and walk to the end.
w.zu: Usuka esangweni, thatha indlela yokuqala ngakwesobunxele uhambe uze ufike ekugcineni.

cw.en: From the gate, walk straight up. It is the first building on your left.
cw.zu: Usuka esangweni, hamba uqonde. Yisakhiwo sokuqala ngakwesobunxele sakho.

ce.en: From the gate, walk straight up. It is the first building on your right.
ce.zu: Usuka esangweni, hamba uqonde. Yisakhiwo sokuqala ngakwesokudla sakho.

e.en: From the gate, take the first path on your right and walk to the end.
e.zu: Usuka esangweni, thatha indlela yokuqala ngakwesokudla uhambe uze ufike ekugcineni.

gate.en: Right next to the gate, on your right as you come in.
